title: Verify natural layered OBJ looping
changes: Compare source-derived original multi-layer looping in draw variant 0 with raw and managed resources.
validation: All 559 frames across 34 layers and 16 banks were reached in 3,457 original draw calls after initialized frame/tick zero in loop mode 0. Full state matches after each call with poisoned managed spans; 450,420 managed bytes were read. Protected inputs passed and scratch was removed: target/validation/units/e130-layered-timing-build-it0g5dm0/ and e130-layered-timing-wine-pjteb7le/.
limitations: Other loop modes, every-frame draw variants 1/2, other consumers and ordinary gameplay remain open. A later translated full-cycle proof passed. Linux, USA and native Windows are separate. No performance measurement.
